listing.style: 1960 ranch mountain home; floor-to-ceiling stone fireplace, picture windows + sliders, 34-ft covered view porch, detached 1-car garage w/ laundry
listing.description: Check out this charming 952 sq ft, 2 bedroom, 1 bathroom mountain home in Wofford Heights! Huge picture windows and front sliders fill the home with natural light and frame views of Lake Isabella and the surrounding mountains. Enjoy new countertops and flooring, an updated bathroom, and an energy efficient mini-split heating and cooling system. The cozy fireplace has a new electric insert. Relax on the covered front patio taking in the views, or enjoy the private backyard where deer often visit. All of this sits on a 12,196 sq ft lot in a safe, quiet neighborhood just minutes from shopping, plus Kernville's restaurants and coffee shops. Perfect as a full-time residence, weekend getaway, or first home!

verdict: An updated, light-filled 1960 lake-view ranch in Wofford Heights with a verified living-level view of Lake Isabella, new counters/floors/bath, mini-splits, a garage workshop, and a fenced yard — the most turnkey getaway candidate yet and the cheapest per sqft, in a real lake-recreation town minutes from Kernville. But it's an in-neighborhood 0.28-ac lot rather than wild nature, and at 6.4 hours from SF it hard-fails the 3h gate. If the radius rule ever relaxes to include the southern Sierra, this is the strongest STR-leaning pick of the set.
